rationale: The current best spends extra compute on the reverse recurrent tail but has only per-block carry/update gates. This adds one tiny learned per-channel exit gate after the recurrent pass, initialized as an exact no-op, so the model can keep useful recurrence while blending unstable dimensions back toward the pre-recurrence decoder anchor. It is compile-stable, keeps VAL_LOSS_EVERY=0 and the exact int8+zlib final path, costs only 512 scalar/control parameters stored in fp32, and targets the live recurrent-tail anchor family without another scalar sweep.
title: Learned Reverse-Tail Exit Blend
